translator: Claude (agent), new translation from the Saturn Japanese in the US arcade's tone; no official English exists (D-066)
approved: 2026-11-07, the user: "Approve all (Recommended)"; the retainer's name "Ambassador Hell (Recommended)"; decisions in docs/localization_policy.md "Saturn-Only Pilots, Decided"
rules: dialogue boxes: tools.text.dialogue.wrap, at most 3 rows and 60 cells; captions one row of at most 26 characters; arcade pair-font characters only (EXP-0078 check_drafts.py)

names.romanized_source: Desu Satan castle and royal house

names.rule: Devilotte as in the arcade English and LOC-004
a Kamen Rider villain's title, known in English as Ambassador Hell
the US arcade's word for the machines

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: The time: the future. The place: outer space.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: In the black void where even light freezes looms the sinister colony of Heldorado.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Devilotte, the Dark Emperor's spoiled daughter, was reaching for Earth...

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: My daughter... Of late, your heart has not been in your evil deeds.

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: One day you will be Dark Empress and rule the galaxy... Explain yourself.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Father! I... I have given my heart to a gentleman!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: ...This one!!

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: What!! Gawaine!? The most righteous man in the whole galaxy...

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: Never!! I forbid it!! That man shall never set foot in Castle Deathsatan!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Wh-what!? How cruel! Father, you're impossible!!

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: You dare!? Then you shall have to defeat me first!!

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: Heh... You have grown strong, Devilotte.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Father!

boxes.speaker: Dark Emperor
boxes.english: Go... out into the great sea of stars. But remember... snacks... 300 yen... limit...
boxes.note: A school-trip joke: Japanese schools cap snack money for outings at about 300 yen. Kept as is.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Fatherrrrrr!!

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: And so Devilotte's journey began...

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Can she slip past the forces of justice and capture Gawaine's heart...?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Bah! I told you not to follow me! This is my affair alone! I need no help from you!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Gwaah!! B-but... Princess...

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Sniff... A hundred years serving House Deathsatan, and this is our thanks...

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Heaven shows villains no mercy, but this is just too sad...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Hold it right there!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: What!? Who goes there!?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: The name's Jin Saotome! The V on my forehead sees through your evil deeds!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Eeek! A hero of justice! We're done for!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Hold it right there!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: What!?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: You're the one who's unforgivable, you cheap knockoff!!
boxes.note: She mocks Jin as a bootleg copy of a TV hero.

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: P-Princesss!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: You said the one thing you must never say! In heaven's name, I'll punish you!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Whaaat!? I lost!? That's impossible...!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Hmph... Fool!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: You must fight fair and square. We villains may use any dirty trick we please!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: You never had a chance!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Ugh... Can justice never triumph over evil...?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: What was it all for...? O wind, O clouds, if you have hearts, tell me...

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princesssss!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Gramps... It's all right now. I'm sorry I worried you.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: As a special favor, I'll let you off with a burning at the stake.

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: GYAAAAAHH!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte, then Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Stein! Turn the flame down a bit! Mercy, Princess! I'm gonna diiie!!

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: Experimented on, then thrown away... Oh, poor, poor me...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Bah, how tiresome!! Don't think crying fixes everything!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: I'll show you what truly pitiful looks like!!

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: Eeeeeek!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Ahh, how refreshing. Nothing like a little evil to lift the spirits.

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: I'm... still alive...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Now then... What sort of experiment was it?
boxes.note: Literally she puts the question in Arieta's mouth; the sense is 'tell me'.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Speak!!

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: I'll talk!! The Earth Corps kidnaps kids like us to power their secret weapons...

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: ...and then throws us away!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: How fun! I must have a piece of that! Come, Ambassador Hell! Dr. Stein!

boxes.speaker: Henchmen
boxes.english: Yes, mistress!!
boxes.note: As the US arcade's henchmen answer her.

boxes.speaker: Arieta
boxes.english: Wait... don't leave me... Oh... I can see a field of flowers...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: So hooot... Isn't the air conditioner fixed yet!?

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Yes, Princess! Stein is working flat out on it. Just a little longer...

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: Who are you!? I bet you're here to take Mao away from me too!!

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: Big brother, I'm scared...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: We haven't done anything yet. That part starts now!!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: I lost... Go on, do what you want with me!!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: But don't you lay a finger on Mao...

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: Big brother!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Hmph... Sibling love, is it? How touching.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Doctor! Fuse the two of them into one monster. They'll never be apart!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: Heh... Mao, now we'll be together forever.

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: Yeah... big brother...

boxes.speaker: A cyborg
boxes.english: Saotome...? What... am I...?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: What are you, he asks! Hopeless... Aha! You're one of the Earth Corps' cyborgs!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: And a brooding one, too! Your kind always ends up a hero of justice.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Justice must be nipped in the bud!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Hmph. You gave me some trouble...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: You shall be reborn as a cyborg with the power of an octopus!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Fear not! You'll get a faulty conscience circuit and a self-destruct device! Seize him!!
boxes.note: The bracketed (incomplete) becomes 'faulty': the font has no brackets.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: ...So this is the new weapon, the Capture Beam? Then... click!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Wh-what are these numbers? 9... 8... They're counting down!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: What's that? ...The wrong button!?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Execution!!
boxes.note: Her catchphrase, also her first win quote.

boxes.speaker: A cyborg
boxes.english: Ugh... Saotome...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Whew, that was close... We survived by a hair, Doctor!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princess, an emergency! Someone is approaching our cyberbot... Ah! Hey, you!!

boxes.speaker: A young hero
boxes.english: So it's you! The three villains in that shameless cyberbot, terrorizing everyone!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Another hero of justice. They never stop coming.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: ...Tell me, boy. What do you fight for?

boxes.speaker: A young hero
boxes.english: To end this long war and bring peace to all. For that, I'd gladly lay down my life!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Fool!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: I do as I please! Fail your own desires, and you'll never satisfy the masses!

boxes.speaker: A young hero
boxes.english: Ugh... Our noble cause won't be crushed by this! Waaah! You'll pay for this!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Are you sure we should let them go...?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Let them go. Losing to them once they're grown will be fun. Such is the way of evil.

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Yes, mistress!! "My, how the Princess has grown..."
boxes.note: The aside in brackets becomes quoted thought (no brackets in the font). Its first Japanese line is shared with a roster box; this box gets its own English.

boxes.speaker: An Earth Corps officer
boxes.english: Even now, I cannot support this plan. Using innocent children as test subjects...

boxes.speaker: His superior
boxes.english: It weighs on me too... But it beats plunging Earth into a century of war.

boxes.speaker: His superior
boxes.english: ...For the future of mankind, we must bear the shame!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Sniff... What a lovely story.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Kidnapping a kindergarten bus, poisoning the dam... the basics of villainy.

boxes.speaker: His superior
boxes.english: !! You were listening!? ...You won't leave here alive!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Ooh, that line's not bad either.

boxes.speaker: His superior
boxes.english: Curses... Now the plan... the future of mankind...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: No need to fret. The future of mankind belongs to me. You may rest easy!

boxes.speaker: His superior
boxes.english: Oh, well, that's all right then!
boxes.note: The heart glyph is dropped: the font has none.

boxes.speaker: The officer
boxes.english: Wait, WHAT!?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: If you like, I'll hire you as an executive. Mecha-beasts and monsters included. Interested?

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: By the way, Princess, what shall we do with the test-subject brats?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: ...Just letting them go is so dull. I know! Ship them home and turn them into foot soldiers.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Still... Lord Gawaine, wherever have you gone?

boxes.speaker: The secret weapon
boxes.english: Shoooo... Fshhhh... Blub blub blub...

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: THIS is the Earth Corps' secret weapon!?

boxes.speaker: Dr. Stein
boxes.english: How dare they build something this big behind our backs! Grrr, no fair!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Calm down!! A blubbering lump of brains is not final boss material!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: I'll show it who truly rules this universe!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princess...!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Spoken like the true heir of House Deathsatan... She who rises from hell to sow ruin,

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Queen of tyranny and plunder, Her Majesty Princess Devilotte de Deathsatan IX!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Too long-winded!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Now, if I bring him this thing's head, won't Lord Gawaine be pleased?

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: "You are the woman I have waited for!" Eek! As if!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princesssss! This thing is nothing BUT a head!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: And then, beneath a sky full of stars, the two of us... Oh, I can't say the rest! Eek!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: -- Execution!! --

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Wipe out every last one of them!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: My empire has no use for vulgar riffraff!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: If they have no bread, let them eat cake...

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Let the poor eat barley!!
boxes.note: A famous Japanese political gaffe of 1950.

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: What a fine puppet I've won... Doctor! Do with it as you like!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Justice is powerless before love!!
Farewell, Heldorado
Justice Utterly Crushed
Sorrow, I Want You
The Tragic Sibling Beast
The Cyborg of Tears
Pardon My Nakedness
Star of the Servants
The Crown Shines on Me
Forever Love

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: I did it!! I've finally beaten Lord Gawaine!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princess!!

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Heh... To think you beat me, a 100th-dan gateball master!
boxes.note: Gateball is a croquet-like sport played by elderly people in Japan; the joke is kept.

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: You are worthy to be my lifelong partner. I shall take you as my wife!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Eeeeeek!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: Fool!!

boxes.speaker: Devilotte
boxes.english: You will not take me as your wife!! I will take YOU as my husband!!!

boxes.speaker: Ambassador Hell
boxes.english: Princess...!!

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Heh... Well said! Then let us go to your homeland!!

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: ...And so Princess Devilotte became the evil empress of the whole galaxy,

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: and House Deathsatan ruled all the stars, crushing its people, and prospered.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: She later conquered the universe and named herself "Demon Empress Lovely Devilotte," but

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: that is another story.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: "Super Galactic Legend, Chapter 13: Devilotte Forever" -- THE END --
